About Ubiquiti
 At Ubiquiti Inc., we create technology platforms for Businesses, Smart Homes, and Internet Service Providers, driven by our goal to connect everyone, everywhere. To date, Ubiquiti has shipped over 100 million devices worldwide, from ISP networking products to next generation of IT solutions. Our growth is made possible by the dedicated team of hundreds behind the scenes. From software developers and product managers to designers and strategists, Team UI is driven to achieve our common goal: Rethinking IT. At Ubiquiti, you’ll heighten your potential and broaden your horizons - all while shaping the future of connectivity.
 Responsibilities
Plan and execute manual test strategies for Layer 2/Layer 3 switching platforms, ProAV (Audio/Video over IP), and associated UI software.
Validate features related to VLAN, QoS, IGMP snooping, multicast routing, Dante, and network-based audio/video control protocols.
Design and maintain test cases in collaboration with developers, product managers, and system architects.
Perform functional, regression, performance, and stress testing on web interfaces, mobile apps, and embedded device firmware.
Log detailed and reproducible issues in Jira; verify fixes and provide input on root cause analysis.
Analyze system behavior across multiple platforms (Web, Mobile, Networked Devices).
Contribute to test documentation including test plans, bug reports, and test summaries.
 Requirements
3+ years of experience in manual QA for Networking products or ProAV systems
Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test case management tools (TestRail, Zephyr, etc.).
Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.
Familiarity with networking concepts (VLANs, switching, routing, WiFi, VPNs, OSI model).
Exposure to AV protocols and devices such as Dante, Q-Sys, Crestron.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Fluency in English and Romanian (written and spoken).
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and agile team environment.
 Nice to Have
Basic scripting knowledge in Python or Bash for test automation or log analysis.
Experience testing or working with Ethernet switches, PoE, AVB/TSN, or broadcast-level streaming protocols.
Familiarity with embedded systems, SNMP, or remote device debugging.
Previous experience working with Ubiquiti or similar enterprise networking hardware.
 Benefits
International work environment and work with global development teams;
Compensation package matching global standards;
Flexible work hours (as required);
Paid parking, courses, training, conferences and business trips.
 We will contact candidates who meet our criteria within the next two weeks.
